title: AntiMobs
description: That disables mob spawning in a designated area, and includes explosion protection.
body:
This plugin allows you to disable hostile mobs in a designated area, and also disables creeper and TNT explosions. It's well-suited for spawn areas and vanilla servers that want to avoid using region protection plugins.

The plugin's uniqueness lies in its ease of use. You just need to select two points and save them, and with each server load, it will always be active in that area. You can also change them manually through the config.

Commands:

/ampos1 - Selects the first point.

/ampos2 - Selects the second point.

/amsave - Saves the selected area.
